statement: One OperationWorkflowOwner decision, bound to the exact durable create attempt and authoritative replica lifecycle generation, governs both ADD/REPLACE terminal-failure admission and failed-target cleanup. A live or unresolved target is never removed from projected cache state; an admitted-but-closed target is removable only after positive generation-matched FAILED evidence; stale FAILED, absent, mismatched, and unavailable observations cannot authorize a terminal failure or cleanup.

constraints.statement: OperationWorkflowOwner owns one typed authoritative create-target terminal and cleanup decision. ReplicaHandler supplies durable lifecycle evidence, UnifiedRebalancer consumes the decision, and neither planner nor cache projection may independently infer cleanup eligibility.

A FAILED lifecycle observation authorizes only the exact durable create attempt and replica incarnation that produced it. The permitted FAILED to CREATING retry for a never-opened replica cannot race a stale failure admission or cleanup into a later live generation.

Only positive authoritative, exact-target lifecycle evidence may authorize terminal failure or cleanup. UNAVAILABLE, mismatched, and absent observations are typed non-eligibility; cache rows and committed-membership projections never substitute for lifecycle authority.

ReplicaHandler fences the failed runtime and confirms the exact durable FAILED transition before emitting a terminal create-failure outcome. If persistence is unresolved, an existing named level-triggered owner must retain and re-drive the obligation; no timeout increase, fallback writer, or one-shot wake is allowed.

The same production route proves projected SYNCING plus authoritative ACTIVE is retained, projected SYNCING plus exact authoritative FAILED is cleaned, a stale FAILED cannot cross FAILED to CREATING retry, and an observation paused before activation cannot later commit FAILED.
Every source attempt requires independent verification newer than the attempt and recorded with verifier subagent:<id> before landing.
